info.name: SLTProject - All Controllers + Email-First + Push + Operational Alerts + Global Hangfire - 2026-11-09
info.description: Updated from user supplied Nov 5 collection and checked against SLT_Global_Hangfire_Operational_Notifications_Updated.zip. Original requests retained. New requests cover guest email-first login, invitation delivery, SMS templates, inbox, push proxy, operational alert scheduler, and import modes. Use staging only for destructive, credential-changing or message-sending requests. Import file paths must be selected manually. Example notification/provider payloads may require actual device SDK output. Date values in API examples use ISO 8601.
